feeds.title: Chicago Vintage Clothing and Jewelry Show Blog
feeds.description: The Vintage Clothing and Jewelry Blog! We discuss all types of vintage clothing and jewelry. Collections, brands, eras, cleaning, fixing, finding and more!

feeds.title: Boylerpf Antique & Vintage Jewelry
feeds.description: Boylerpf is the place where you will find some of the best affordable antique & vintage jewelry from the Victorian, Edwardian, Art Nouveau, Art Deco jewelry & retro chic.

feeds.title: DSF Antique Jewelry Blog
feeds.description: Fine Jewelry: Earrings, Bracelets, Cufflinks, Rings, Necklaces & Brooches. Vintage & Antique Jewelry, Watches, Chanel Costume Jewelry, Tiffany & Co. Jewelry, Cartier, Van Cleef & Arpels, and more.

feeds.title: Vintage Jewelry Supplies Blog
feeds.description: The Vintage Jewelry Supplies Company Inc. is the leader in handmade jewelry making supplies. We have been serving jewelry designers since 1989 as a major source for brass stamping components plated in rich antique patinas including oxidized sterling silver, brass and copper. We will freely share ideas, instructions, motivation, and the history of the jewelry we love.

feeds.title: Christine Wallace...'Honoring Life Through Jewelry'
feeds.description: I'm a 40-something jewelry designer living my dream of creating and designing one-of-a-kind vintage jewelry near the beautiful beaches of Florida. I have been making jewelry now since my early 20's and within the past several years dove into this lifelong passion of mine full time. With my blog I hope to share my jewelry dreams and designs with you and I hope you enjoy them.

feeds.title: The Long's Jewelers Blog » Estate
feeds.description: Long's Jewelers, voted Boston's Best Jeweler, is New England's source for diamonds, diamond engagement rings, wedding rings, fine jewelry, watches, & pearls. From vintage to pre-owned jewelry, Long's Jewelers will show you some original, one-of-a-kind pieces!

feeds.title: Chic Antiques by Pamela
feeds.description: Pamela Wiggins Siegel is an online purveyor of vintage and collectible jewelry. She is also a freelance writer specializing in antiques and collectibles. She occasionally shares other personal, professional, and jewelry-related news there as well.

feeds.title: Vintage Meet Modern
feeds.description: Our carefully curated collection debunks the myth that vintage is old, old dated, unusable, or unattainable. We strive to find pieces in excellent condition, rich in fashion history and tradition and perfectly suited to compliment today's modern styles.

feeds.title: Lillicoco Blog
feeds.description: Lillicoco is all about Fine antique & vintage jewellery from around the world and across the ages. Lillicoco's source only the finest vintage jewels for you to choose from; ranging from Art Deco to Mid century... from Georgian to modern day. We specialize in fine jewellery from Edwardian & Victorian times, as well as Diamonds & coloured gemstones.

feeds.title: Karen Deakin Antiques Antique and Vintage Jewellery Blog
feeds.description: I've been a dealer in antique jewellery since 1978. Authenticity and condition are paramount to me, as is my reputation. I truly love what I do.

feeds.title: Jean Jean Vintage
feeds.description: Vintage and antique jewelry, costume and fine. Specializing in 1920s-1940s with a great selection of Victorian rings, Eastern European (Czech) jewelry and Art Deco costume jewelry.

feeds.title: The Jewellery Muse Blog
feeds.description: The Jewellery Muse is written by Nicole, a jewellery enthusiast who's been collecting vintage and antique jewellery (and making her own too) since the 1990s. Whether old collectibles or modern costume, fine designer gemstone or local artisan handmade, the Muse is passionate about all jewellery, and celebrates it here.

feeds.title: AC Silver News
feeds.description: A blog about AC Silver, diamond and silver news, reviews and business updates on antique, Vintage and Contemporary Silverware & Jewellery.

feeds.title: Sweet & Spark - Timeless Style, Vintage Jewelry & Home Decor Blog
feeds.description: A modern and feminine blog inspired by our favorite timeless designers, fashion icons, vintage jewelry and home decor over the 50s, 60s, 70s, 80s and 90s. We love to style brooches, scarves and clip-on statement earrings.

feeds.title: TruFaux Jewels Blog
feeds.description: TruFaux Jewels offers vintage costume jewelry, accessories & styling tips for women with far from ordinary tastes. Collection of articles by an expert on jewelry history, styling tips for wearing vintage jewelry with contemporary fashion, unique gift ideas and more.

feeds.title: Eric Originals & Antiques Blog
feeds.description: Get ready to be dazzled as Eric Originals unveils its collections of timeless jewelry pieces in this blog. Eric Originals focuses on antique and estate jewelry and carries a whole variety of cushion cut and old mine diamond engagement rings, as well as signed original pieces from iconic designers like Van Cleef & Arpels, Tiffany & Co. or Cartier
